budgeting.issueText: I'm Maya, and I bring home $2,800 a month but spend about $2,750 of it. Takeout from Noodle Nest is about $420 a month, and StreamStack subscriptions add another $48. Six days before payday my checking account is down to $90. I keep running out of money before the next paycheck.

saving.issueText: I'm Jordan, and I earn $3,400 a month and spend about $2,100, so money is left over. I only have $220 in savings, which would not cover even one month of spending. I never move money into savings, so I do not have a savings habit. I also do not have an emergency fund if a surprise bill shows up.

debt.issueText: I'm Sam, and I owe $2,400 on a credit card at 24.99% APR, plus an $8,000 loan at 6.5% APR. The card's minimum payment is $70, and about $50 of that is interest, so the balance barely moves. I also pay $180 a month on the loan. I earn $3,600 and spend about $2,400, but the high-interest card is the debt that will not shrink.
